scoring_justification: Cannot recompute from raw artifacts as the agent only submits final aggregated values; the hidden checker compares the agent's reported numbers to the paper's reference values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for luminescence enhancement factor and absorption losses extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: J. Appl. Phys. 114, 223104 (2013). Values from text: 'The maximal enhancement factor is ... 2.8 ... for a wavelength ~540 nm' (Sec. III C) and '93% of the light is lost ... 77% in the grated structure' (Sec. III D, Fig. 8(c)).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published quantities under the exact experimental conditions specified in the task.

outputs.description: Luminescence enhancement factor at λ=540 nm; higher is better, meeting or exceeding the paper's result earns full credit.
Absorption loss percentages at λ=540 nm; lower is better, meeting or undershooting the paper's losses earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are for TM polarization and averaged over x- and z-oriented dipole sources in the quantum well. The grating period is 200 nm with a 50% duty cycle. The silver and GaN/InGaN permittivities are taken from the public references listed in resources.

steps.description: Check luminescence enhancement factor against paper value.
Check absorption loss percentages for ungrated and grated structures.
